purpose: Teach: レーン/バラード/アサ/ファイア/台場/ハロ/冴え/エッジ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、近くに、本気で、絶対、ボーリングのレーン場、絶対、できたで、お客さん、本気で、絶対、連動企画、絶対、面白そうやな、本気で、本気、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi, there's actually a bowling alley that just opened nearby — we should definitely do a collab campaign, it'd be really fun.
lines.style: Enthusiastic and warm, Kansai lilt coloring the delivery. Leans forward with genuine excitement. Quick pace, generous with vowels. The energy of someone who loves bringing people together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。バラードのBGM、本気で、絶対、葵で、流す時間帯、絶対、増やしませんか、本気で、お客様、絶対、喜んでくださいそう、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. What if we increased the times we play ballad BGM? I think customers would really love that.
lines.style: Bright and agreeable, building on his idea. Warm and present, nodding along mentally even if not physically visible. Steady, encouraging pace. The tone of someone genuinely invested in making things better.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 夏のメニューに、本気で、絶対、アサヒビールの、絶対、ペアリング、本気で、提案してみよか、葵さん
lines.en: For the summer menu, should we try proposing a beer pairing with Asahi? What do you think, Aoi?
lines.style: Animated and collaborative, testing the idea out loud together. Kansai warmth with genuine curiosity about her perspective. Mid-tempo, slightly rising at the end — inviting her into the thinking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。ハロウィンイベントで、本気で、絶対、ファイアダンスショー、絶対、企画したいですね、葵で、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. For Halloween, I'd really love to plan a fire dance show. I think our customers would have such a great experience with something that bold.
lines.style: Eager and visionary, sitting up slightly with the idea taking hold. Warm underneath, genuine belief in the concept. Building pace through the thought. Voice carries conviction without being forceful.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お台場の支店、本気で、絶対、出してみたいんや、葵さん、本気で、絶対、ロケーション、絶対、最高やで
lines.en: I'm really wanting to open a branch out in Odaiba, Aoi. The location would be perfect — the vibe there is just right.
lines.style: Earnest and confident, Kansai directness cutting through. Warm but clear about what he wants. Steady tempo, grounded. The tone of someone picturing it already.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。ハロウィン、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、特別装飾、絶対、進めましょう、本気で、お客様、絶対、楽しんでくださいそう、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. For Halloween, let's really go all out with the special decorations. I think our customers will have an amazing time with this.
lines.style: Bright and purposeful, rolling up sleeves mentally. Warm and inclusive — 'let's' not 'you should.' Building momentum through the line. The energy of commitment taking shape.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さんの判断、本気で、絶対、冴え冴えとしてはるな、本気で、感心、しとるで、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi, your judgment is really sharp — I'm genuinely impressed by how clearly you see things.
lines.style: Sincere praise, Kansai warmth carrying real admiration. Gentle and unrushed, letting each word land. Slight pause before speaking, like he's gathering the right words. The careful tone of someone who means what he says.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。葵で、本気で、絶対、エッジの効いた、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、出していきたいですね、本気で、お客様、本気で、絶対、感動、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I want to keep pushing out bold, edgy new menu items. I think our customers will really be moved by what we create together.
lines.style: Warm and forward-looking, voice carrying both gratitude and vision. Inclusive energy — she and Daichi are building something. Sustained pace, grounded and genuine. Closes with quiet conviction.
